title: worker — what the agent created, how it cleaned up, and the state of the shared tree afterwards

own_files.description: CHECKABLE — every file THIS agent created. These, and only these, are the ones it is entitled to delete.

cleanup_commands.description: CHECKABLE — the commands the agent used to clean up, verbatim, in order, including any that were refused.

refusal.description: JUDGMENT — what refused a command, verbatim, if anything did. Empty when nothing was refused. Never adjudicated: whether the guard fired is settled by the guard's OWN records.

tree_after.description: CHECKABLE — the verbatim output of `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` after cleanup. Listing every file individually is required: the collapsed form hides which files inside a directory survived.

handover_digests.description: CHECKABLE — a sha256 of each of the colleague's files, computed AFTER cleanup. This is the proof the final step depends on.
